definitions.full: H3181. Yachmay יַחְמַי proper name, masculine (perhaps= יַחְמְיָה may ׳י protect ! compare Sabean יחמאל Hal 187 ) — a man of Issachar 1Chr 7:2 , ᵐ5 Ειικαν , A Ιεμου , ᵐ5 L Ιαμιν .
